title: Spellsiphon Awareness
tagline: Spellsiphon Awareness - Prompts and tiggers bundle
description:
Makes Spellsiphon's siphoned combat readable to SkyrimNet NPCs.

While you hold, attune, or weapon-charge World, Life, or Death, nearby speakers
get a short observational bio block (no combo lectures, no mod names). Payoff
moments — Bind, Discharge, and Woven Power — always log as persistent events;
rare narration can fire when someone is present to see it.

Draw concentration, Ward spam, and utility swaps (Reverse / Refocus / Reshape)
are intentionally not hooked.

REQUIREMENTS
- SkyrimNet
- Spellsiphon - Immersive Combat (Spellsiphon.esp)
